card.name: Inside concomitant and drug-interaction phrasing
card.fires_on: Partway through "concomitant" (con-com-itant) and on linking words just before drug-interaction statements, such as "coadministration of" or "unlikely to alter the". Also fires on a few unrelated words like "suicide" before "bomber".

modes.label: Concomitant spelled out
modes.description: The pieces "com" or "itant" inside the word concomitant, before a drug name.
modes.example: The con<<com>>itant use of dabigatran et

modes.label: Linking words in interaction text
modes.description: Small words such as "of", "the" or "for" just before a statement about drug effects on other drugs.
modes.example: Due to the potential for coadministration<< of>> carbamazepine to result in

modes.label: Stray non-medical word
modes.description: The word suicide in a news story about a bomber.
modes.example: representing this<< suicide>> bomber could do.
